8.3.3 Job Cancellation Interface
[SWS_CryIf_91014] Definition of API function CryIf_CancelJob ⌈
Service Name
CryIf_CancelJob
Syntax
Std_ReturnType CryIf_CancelJob (
uint32 channelId,
Crypto_JobType* job
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0e
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
channelId
Holds the identifier of the crypto channel.
▽
△
Parameters (inout)
job
Pointer to the configuration of the job. Contains structures with
user and primitive relevant information.
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Request successful, job has been removed
E_NOT_OK: Request failed, job couldn’t be removed
CRYPTO_E_JOB_CANCELED
Description
This interface dispatches the job cancellation function to the configured crypto driver object.
Available via
CryIf.h
⌋
[SWS_CryIf_00129] CryIf_CancelJob API: Report CRYIF_E_UNINIT error
Upstream requirements: SRS_CryptoStack_00034, SRS_BSW_00369, SRS_BSW_00406
⌈If development error detection for the CRYIF is enabled: The function CryIf_CancelJob shall report CRYIF_E_UNINIT to the DET if the module is not yet initialized.⌋
[SWS_CryIf_00130] CryIf_CancelJob API: Report CRYIF_E_PARAM_HANDLE error
Upstream requirements: SRS_CryptoStack_00034, SRS_BSW_00369
⌈If development error detection for the CRYIF is enabled: The function CryIf_CancelJob shall report CRYIF_E_PARAM_HANDLE to the DET if the parameter channelId is out of range.⌋
[SWS_CryIf_00131] CryIf_CancelJob API: Report CRYIF_E_PARAM_POINTER error
Upstream requirements: SRS_CryptoStack_00034, SRS_BSW_00369
⌈If development error detection for the CRYIF is enabled: The function CryIf_CancelJob shall report CRYIF_E_PARAM_POINTER to the DET if the parameter job is a
null pointer.⌋
